records.name: quality-gate-design
records.original_recommendation_zh: 补 PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN 真值表、证据过期、例外授权人/期限与 fail-closed 条件；用缺失测试记录 fixture 验证不能默认为通过。

records.repair_en: Define each obligation, evidence version/freshness, operator and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN table. Execution prevented is BLOCKED; missing or indeterminate evidence is UNKNOWN; absence never means PASS. Apply project aggregation and fail-closed rules. Preserve unknown/blocked causes and recommend advancement only when all required gates have fresh valid evidence.

records.repair_en: Fix the project's framework, dimensions, anchors and scope. Without a framework provide candidate anchors and evidence, not ratings or a repository Quality Score. Relevant but unauthorized hits are failures; high scores cannot cure stale content.

records.name: regression-scope-analysis

records.original_recommendation_en: Add change-to-obligation, layer/platform, and inclusion/exclusion mappings. Test indirect dependencies and insufficient budgets without treating unknown impact as excluded.
records.repair_zh: 以变更和当前基线为入口，列变更→受影响义务→测试层/平台/数据状态→纳入/排除及证据的矩阵；回归保护已有行为，不把新特性完整测试混为回归。；检查直接、传递与动态依赖、历史逃逸和非功能影响；未知依赖单列，不以无映射当无影响，排除需契约/证据证明。
records.repair_en: Map changes and current baseline to affected obligations, layers/platforms/data states, include/exclude decisions and evidence. Regression protects existing behavior; new-feature acceptance is distinct. Check direct, transitive and dynamic dependencies, historical escapes and nonfunctional impact. Unknown mappings are not proof of no impact; exclusion needs an evidenced boundary.
